positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Own end-to-end app management on Horizon OS (Meta Quest), spanning device-side system services, the Meta Horizon companion app, and the Hack backend.

Proposed and delivered a remote app install framework, raising install reliability from 77% to 92% and driving statistically significant gains in companion-app DAU and engagement.

Delivered cloud backup for the Quest browser, lifting Browser time spent.

Re-architected the default-apps install pipeline, taking install success from 85% to 99% across the standard Quest default app set.

positions.title: Sr Associate Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on the JMP desktop product as part of the portable development team. Wrote and maintained C++ code that was delivered as part of the main product, primarily for the GraphBuilder and new Structural Equation Modeling platforms. Developed Ruler Graph Tool, Size Legend, and various labeling options for use in JMP's graphs. Primary developer for JMP’s Structural Equation Modeling diagram component. Collaborated with statisticians to deliver a functional and interactive user interface for designing and developing SEM models graphically. Developed and implemented efficient layout algorithms in C++, such as hierarchical drawing, for use in displaying arbitrary network diagrams.
